cause: Readied knives were parented to the hidden gameplay rig instead of the selected character's native hand.
fix: Parent the held knife to the selected character's hand and fit its handle to the palm.
Preserve world weapon size when reparenting between rigs with different FBX units.
Reattach or recreate the knife when the selected character changes.
Start the cosmetic knife flight at the visible grip and converge onto the unchanged authoritative trajectory over 0.1 seconds.
